## Detailed Findings

#### 1. One-row-per-tool-call UI refactor (ui, ~8h, CONSIDER)

- **What**: Cline #13186 one-row-per-tool-call UI refactor. Replaced consecutive-call grouping ('Read 3 files · Ran 2 commands') with one row per tool call, each with its own icon, status, disclosure, and treatment per kind. Commands read like a terminal: '$ bun run test' in monospace, with captured output in capped scrollable mono block on expand and '$ '-prefixed detail lines for multi-command calls. Edit rows carry mono filenames, +/- badge, pierre diffs pre-expanded (one diff per hunk for multi-hunk patches), keeping user-toggle override. Reads/searches/fetches keep inline specifics with mono code segments via shared labelParts. Fixes: test:chat-ui exit-1 regression (CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync polyfill in jsdom for @pierre/diffs custom element), thinking indicator stays up during quiet turn stretches (streaming tool-call arguments, no text or tool row on screen), indicator mirrors tool-row trigger metrics (min-h-7, py-1, gap-2, 16px icon, font-medium) so text doesn't shift when indicator swaps with tool row, message actions clear separation from message text (translate-y-1.5 = 6px breathing room), spinner replaces tool icon while call in flight (progress ring took icon slot, label never shifts), align thinking indicator with tool row that replaces it (removed stacked mt-2), message actions match chat text scale in lighter gray (16px icons, text-sm timestamp, 70% muted-foreground, hover brightens to full foreground), running tool rows share thinking indicator's gray (violet-on-running read as different system, spinner signals activity, progress ring draws currentColor), don't unstick conversation follow when content grows (sticking released only by upward scroll, always restored on reaching bottom, transcript keeps following while rows stream), user message bubbles on filled brand-violet surface (card-colored bubble too close to app background), conversation bottom padding above composer, composer keeps two-line height when unfocused (collapsing to one row made input + conversation jump on focus change), AgentAskQuestion simplify (drop 'Follow-up question' heading + intro sentence + box-in-box, question leads card directly with icon + text + buttons, accent shifts blue → brand violet), pending questions and approvals render at transcript end (not banner above conversation), message actions reachable with instant hover/focus (8px offset was translated gap = dead space dropped :hover midway to buttons, now padding on actions element, hover chain unbroken; removes opacity fade on actions + composer focus border transition = lag).
- **Why**: Alexi has TUI (src/cli/tui/, Ink + React 19, tsx files) with basic tool output presentation (src/cli/tui/ChatInterface.tsx likely renders tool results as plain text blocks). One-row-per-tool-call with terminal-style commands, syntax-highlighted diffs, disclosure state, and status colors would significantly improve TUI UX for users debugging agent runs (see individual tool results, expand diffs inline, understand which tool is running vs finished vs failed). Cline's design patterns (mono command formatting, +/- diff badges, pre-expanded edit diffs, status-driven colors) are directly applicable to Ink TUI components. CONSIDER if HIGH UX lift (~8h: split consecutive tool calls into rows in src/cli/tui/ChatInterface.tsx or new src/cli/tui/ToolRow.tsx, add mono formatting for commands/files via chalk/cli-highlight, disclosure state via useState, syntax-highlighted diffs, violet/gray/red status colors) is justified for TUI users (TUI is secondary to CLI non-interactive output, but significantly better for interactive debugging sessions). Size ~8h (add per-call row state, terminal-style command formatting with chalk, disclosure state hooks, diff rendering via cli-highlight or chalk-diff, status color scheme violet/gray/red). Category: ui (TUI). Priority: CONSIDER (significant UX improvement for TUI users, but TUI is secondary surface; high effort; requires design decisions on Ink component patterns).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13186 "refactor(ui): one row per tool call, terminal-style commands, and review fixes" (merged 2026-08-12, commit sha unknown). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13186. Root cause: consecutive-call grouping hid individual tool details; commands didn't read like terminal; thinking indicator disappeared during quiet stretches; message actions had dead hover zones; expanded content faded to 70%. Fix: one row per tool call with icon/status/disclosure, terminal-style command formatting, pre-expanded pierre diffs, thinking indicator stays up, indicator metrics match tool rows, message actions padding (not translate), spinner in icon slot, gray running rows, brand-violet user bubbles, conversation follow unstick only on upward scroll, AgentAskQuestion simplify, pending Q&A at transcript end, message actions instant hover.
- **Category**: ui (TUI). **Size**: ~8h. **Priority**: CONSIDER (significant UX improvement for TUI users, high effort, TUI is secondary surface).

#### 2. Shared tool-summary module (ui, ~3h, SKIP)

Desktop adopts it, replacing ~950 lines of app-local tool extraction in chat-messages.tsx. Also #13153 extract chat transcript logic to messages/ (verbatim moves out of chat-messages.tsx, 2,415 -> ~1,300 lines: shared constants, grouping/reasoning helpers, tool summaries, tool icons under messages/, unit tests for extracted pure logic).

Would be LOW priority if we wanted to extract tool presentation logic into src/cli/tui/tool-summary.ts for consistency (move tool-result formatting, diff parsing, label building into separate module, unit test pure logic). Skip for now (no shared package architecture, TUI is monolithic, low signal for Alexi single-package structure, extraction only valuable if we had multiple consumers).
